limitations: Saved snapshots are not per-frame shoe-section logs; the benchmark frame array contains timing/draw statistics.
This diagnosis concerns vertices 4115/8658 at the original eyelet. The old MP05 fixture jump rear-ankle penetration is separate evidence and is not a measured P01 penetration.
The circle/plane calculations interpret the native design opening and its 24-segment metal bore. They are not a complete skinned-body triangle collision test or a footwear force/comfort solver.
Runtime source, original native assets and the three browser evidence reports were not modified.
